title: M-896
excerpt: A chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment for industrial and weather-resistant coating evaluation, with alumina and silica inorganic coating and organic treatment.

data.h1: M-896 Titanium Dioxide for Industrial Coating Evaluation
hero_paragraphs: M-896 is documented for water-based and solvent-based industrial coatings, coil coatings, protective and marine coatings, automotive OEM and refinish coatings, exterior powder coatings and weather-resistant architectural coatings. Review the typical product data below and confirm suitability through testing in your own formulation, processing and application conditions.

data.positioning_title: Where M-896 Fits in Product Evaluation
positioning_paragraphs: M-896 is a rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced by the chloride process.

Its documented product profile combines alumina and silica inorganic coating with organic treatment and a coatings-focused application range. Use M-896 as a candidate for formulation testing when your project involves industrial or weather-resistant coating systems. Final Grade selection should account for the complete formulation, dispersion process, substrate, application method, service conditions and destination-document requirements.
facts: Evaluation of weather resistance, dispersibility, gloss, blue undertone, opacity and tint strength

applications.title: Water-Based and Solvent-Based Industrial Coatings
applications.text: Evaluate M-896 in the buyer's water-based or solvent-based industrial coating formulation. Confirm dispersion, appearance, compatibility and finished-film performance under the intended application conditions.

applications.title: Coil Coatings
applications.text: Review M-896 in coil-coating systems using the actual resin system, application process, curing conditions and performance requirements for the project.

applications.title: Protective and Marine Coatings
applications.text: Include M-896 in testing for protective and marine coating formulations where weather resistance, dispersion and finished-film properties are part of the evaluation target.

applications.title: Automotive OEM and Refinish Coatings
applications.text: Evaluate color direction, gloss, opacity, tint strength, dispersion and final coating performance in the complete automotive OEM or refinish system.

applications.title: Exterior Powder Coatings
applications.text: Test M-896 in the intended exterior powder-coating formulation and processing conditions, including the coating's appearance and service-performance requirements.

applications.title: Weather-Resistant Architectural Coatings
applications.text: Review M-896 for architectural coating formulations intended for exterior exposure. Confirm the required appearance and weather-resistance performance through formulation and application testing.

data.evaluation_title: What to Evaluate in Your Coating Formulation

evaluation.title: Coating Performance Review
items: Weather-resistance target under the intended service conditions
Gloss and blue-undertone direction in the complete formulation
Finished appearance after the intended application and curing process

evaluation.title: Formulation Qualification Review
items: Dispersion behavior in the selected binder and processing system
Compatibility with the full formulation and additives
Water-based or solvent-based processing conditions, where applicable
Substrate, application method, destination requirements and sample-validation results
